title: Give an AI analyst a June 30 cutoff. See if it quotes numbers first published in August.
author: thinq-81
selftext:
A company can finish its quarter on June 30 and release the results weeks later. Every number in a historical memo can be accurate while the entire conclusion relies on information the investor couldn’t have known.

We built filing-availability dates into Market Ontology’s equity research. Pick a ticker you know and ask Analyst for a memo as of the day *before* its earnings release. Ask for the publication date beside every financial figure. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

comments.author: thinq-81
comments.body: Derived Q4 figures are a good second test. If the model subtracts nine-month results from the full year, check when the full-year number became public. Give it that constraint explicitly. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
